# mt2.ui.document

Draw a resizable document with lists, columns, text inputs and buttons.

Introduced in Lua API **1.1.0**.

```lua
mt2.ui.document(document: MT2Document): MT2DocumentResult
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `document` | `MT2Document` | `Required` | Owned document tree with stable widget IDs, at most 200 widgets, depth 8 and four columns. |

## Contract

- **Returns:** MT2DocumentResult
- **Thread:** Render callback.
- **When to call:** Active render callback. Do not nest inside mt2.ui.window.
- **Effects:** Draws the complete document this frame. Stop submitting after open becomes false. Store changes from values and process clicked once.
- **Reload:** Owned UI registrations are replaced when the new Lua instance first renders; failed preparation retains the old instance.
- **Persistence:** Session-local. Store input values and open state in Lua.
- **Capabilities:** `ui`
- **Since:** 1.1.0
- **Stability:** experimental

## Errors

- Missing capability or inactive/staging owner raises a Lua error.
- Invalid widgets, dimensions or budgets are rejected before drawing.
- Use globally unique widget IDs within a document for unambiguous clicked and values results.
- Lua document images are not available; use a native image widget for packaged PNGs.

## Example

This complete example is also available under `examples/document-app/main.lua` in the source and SDK documentation bundle. Native effects require the real game.

```lua
-- SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
local open, search, selected = false, "", "Scenery"
local choices = {"Scenery", "Shops", "Monsters"}

mt2.events.on("render", function()
    local app = mt2.ui.app({id="main", title="Lua document browser"})
    if app.open_requested then open = true end
    if not open then return end
    local rows = {{type="input", id="search", hint="Filter names...", value=search}}
    for index, name in ipairs(choices) do
        if name:lower():find(search:lower(), 1, true) then
            rows[#rows+1] = {type="selectable", id="choice_"..index,
                title=name, subtitle="Example category", selected=selected==name}
        end
    end
    local result = mt2.ui.document({id="browser", title="Lua document browser",
        width=780, height=460, content={type="columns", children={
            {type="panel", id="list", width=280, children=rows},
            {type="panel", id="detail", children={
                {type="text", tone="heading", text=selected},
                {type="text", text="Select a category or filter the list."},
                {type="button", id="close", text="Close"}
            }}
        }}})
    search = result.values.search or search
    open = result.open
    for _, id in ipairs(result.clicked) do
        if id == "close" then open = false end
        for index, name in ipairs(choices) do
            if id == "choice_"..index then selected = name end
        end
    end
end)
```
